lines: If the tale I heard on sleepless nights were merely a fantasy
To pursue pleasure and lament the present instead of knowing eternity
If it is to escape the shadow that resides deep in the heart
Even so, if I can keep loving myself
A sun split in two brings the morning, subtly stirring nerves accustomed to darkness
The forgotten mind stays deliberately as it is, a story whose script has disappeared
Take the helm freely and rise even higher
I cannot hear the child's voice crying behind the imposed answer
Emotions are not measured by anyone's rusted ruler
Not for anyone else, I hide my wounds so that I can laugh at the present
I sing a fantasy with a slightly hoarse voice; everything that exists here and now is all there is
With the sun split in two, today begins again; the story's continuation rests in my hands
Because being loved is not the ending, mere fulfillment will not suffice
Take the helm freely and become a bird, soaring farther
Take the helm freely and become a star, rising higher
